title: sparse-edge-graceful: certificates, code and manuscript for edge-graceful trees with few vertices of degree two
description: Code, certificate catalogue and manuscript for the theorem that every tree of odd order n with D vertices of degree two is edge-graceful once n exceeds an absolute constant times (D+1)(log n)^A, and, under the abelian improvement of Muyesser and Pokrovskiy's zero-sum matching theorem, once n exceeds an absolute constant times (D+1). Includes the exact constraint search, an independent checker that shares no code with it (5716/5716 families verified), the bottom-up scheduler and its regressions, the closure check, and the constructor. Code and data are under the MIT License; the paper/ directory is under CC BY 4.0.
